# Claude Code Environment Variables: Features and Gates

These 82 environment variables of Claude Code `2.1.303` cover switches that turn a feature on or off.
Many of them start with `DISABLE_` or `ENABLE_`.
An environment variable is a named setting that you put in your shell or in the `env` key of `settings.json`.

## Example

Run `export DISABLE_DOCTOR_COMMAND=1` before `claude` to remove the `/doctor` command.
Or put `{ "env": { "DISABLE_DOCTOR_COMMAND": "1" } }` in `~/.claude/settings.json`.

## Variables

The marks are explained on the [index](Claude-Code-Env-Vars#marks).
